label: GO step after an unrewarded trial, early in the episode
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass), and almost only when the previous trial was unrewarded (prev_reward==0 holds 99.9% of mass; never on rewarded or D1/D2 steps). It is also strongly restricted to the first ~25 trials of an episode: rate 16.7x at ep_trial 1, 8x at 3-9, 4x at 10-19, ~0 after trial 30. Activation is largest in the earliest trials. GO & prev_reward==0 alone gets recall 0.99 but precision 0.08; adding an ep_trial cutoff trades recall for precision (ep_trial<25: P 0.37 R 0.98; <15: P 0.55 R 0.78). I recorded <17 as a compromise. The decay is gradual, so this looks like an early-episode / uncertainty signal and not a hard cutoff. Within that window it fires more when the agent is about to choose a1 (model_act a1 71% of mass) and after earlier unrewarded trials, but conditioning on these lowered F1. Uses only observed variables (ep_trial is implicit in the agent's state).
